variants.specifics: Brackenford: Ulric, an old shepherd at the edge of the Ashwood, pays to have the wolves that take his sheep killed.

offer.speaker: Ulric
offer.text: Honestly, my flock has shrunk quite a lot, with wolves prowling out of the Ashwood. I'll pay good gold to whoever thins that pack.

reminder.speaker: Ulric
reminder.text: Hunter! Go out after that wolf pack!

completion.speaker: Ulric
completion.text: Fine work, young sir! This gold will surely help me rebuild the flock those wolves scattered across my pasture. It seems no beast in the Ashwood can stand against you!

variants.writer: Claude Agent SDK subagent, Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5)

variants.specifics: Vurn: Mayor Durvin pays to have giant Scorpions cleared from the new tunnel Kettrin dug under the West Gallery.

offer.speaker: Durvin
offer.text:
Until we find some way to drive off Grutt's Trolls, I have a smaller job for you to do.

Word has come from Kettrin, one of my diggers, that giant Scorpions have made a nest in his new tunnel.

An old air shaft runs down from the West Gallery to the lower tunnels. Our miners dug it long ago to bring them fresh air. Kettrin's tunnel is at the bottom, and a ladder by the water barrels will take you down.

Get rid of those Scorpions and bring Kettrin the good news.

Good luck, my son!

completion.speaker: Durvin
completion.text: Well done! This bow is the finest in Vurn. The quiver is full of iron arrows, which can pierce a Troll's hide.

journal.text: Find the Scorpion nest and clear it out.

variants.specifics: Tarrow: Hulda, a fisherwife, pays gold to have the Giant Leeches of the south pools killed.

offer.speaker: Hulda
offer.text:
Giant Leeches have crawled into my husband's fish traps again! Unless somebody drives them off, we'll starve this winter. And he's back at dusk!

Oh, please, young sir, help me! They must breed in the south pools.

Could you... would you kill them for us, for a bit of gold?

reminder.speaker: Hulda
reminder.text: Quickly now, young sir, clear out those wretched Leeches!

completion.speaker: Hulda
completion.text: We never should've set traps so near those pools. I wonder if that mad witch bred the Leeches. Here's your gold.

journal.text: Wade out to the south pools and rid Hulda's fish traps of the Giant Leeches.

variants.specifics: Varnhold: Hesk, a goatherd below the castle walls, pays to be rid of the Wolves of the Gloomwood.

offer.speaker: Hesk
offer.text:
There it is, lad, the Gloomwood. That's where the Wolves come from every night.

A little ways into those trees you'll find their den, under the hill. They've taken half my herd. Get rid of them and I'll make it worth your while!

You're my last hope.

reminder.speaker: Hesk
reminder.text: You set to go hunt those Wolves now? Just the one den, and the whole pack inside!

completion.speaker: Hesk
completion.text: My goats! They're safe at last! Bless you a hundred times over! And here, take these boots. I've chased many a goat in them. They'd serve any traveler well.

journal.text:
Hunt down the Wolves in order to protect Hesk's goats.

Their den lies somewhere in the Gloomwood.

variants.specifics: Skarra: Torvy, a fishing crew boss, wants the giant leeches cleared out of the south reeds.

offer.speaker: Torvy
offer.text:
Oh, bah! Leeches in the shallows again?! Sometimes I think they come back just to spoil my mornings. It's not easy keeping a fishing crew fed, you know. We're hauling in the season's best catch today and we can't have leeches on every line when the nets come up.

Tell you what... Clear those leeches out of the south reeds and the wooden shield off my boat is yours!

reminder.speaker: Torvy
reminder.text: Hurry up with those leeches! The boats are waiting to go out.

completion.speaker: Torvy
completion.text:
Splendid work! You've chased off the leeches! Now there's just the catch to haul in.

Here's your shield!

journal.text: Clear the giant leeches out of the south reeds.

variants.specifics: Zanthis: Tibba asks the player to burn out the Wasps' nest plaguing her uncle Bastel's orchard; Bastel pays the bounty.

offer.speaker: Tibba
offer.text:
The Wasps just swarmed all over my uncle's precious orchard! If they aren't gone soon, he'll be ruined. The pickers come next week!

Oh, please help us, young sir! I think their nest hangs in the big oak by the pond. Could you... would you burn it out for us?

reminder.speaker: Tibba
reminder.text: It gladdens me to see a stout hero go after the Wasps that torment my poor uncle.

completion.speaker: Tibba
completion.text: You made it back! Go find Uncle Bastel -- he has your bounty at his farmhouse by the east gate.

journal.text: Bastel's orchard has just been overrun, but the Wasps' nest is still somewhere among the trees. Maybe there's a bounty for burning it...

variants.specifics: Fort Kessry: Brunko Tallow, a goatherd of the fort, pays to have the White Wolves cleared from the ice caves above his pens.

offer.speaker: Brunko Tallow
offer.text: Well met, stranger! Brunko Tallow's the name! You look like a fellow who isn't afraid of a fight, so I thought I'd put a deal to you. The last time the snow came down, the White Wolves crept into my goat pens... And they dragged off my best nannies. The pack should still be holed up in the ice caves above the fort. I'll pay you handsomely once you've cleared them out.

reminder.speaker: Brunko Tallow
reminder.text:
Those wolves must be driven off! YOU have the might to end their raiding.

Hurry! Each night they grow bolder.

completion.speaker: Brunko Tallow
completion.text: Thank goodness the pack is finished! You'll make a fine wolf hunter, lad. Here are the 100 gold pieces I promised for clearing them off my pens.

journal.text: Bounty accepted! Slay the White Wolves above the fort!

variants.specifics: Ferrik: Dobrin the smith pays a bounty to clear the Fire Bats roosting in the Slag Pits.

offer.speaker: Dobrin
offer.text:
Look there, lad. The Slag Pits -- ancient workings of the master smiths of Ferrik! Roost of the foulest Fire Bats ever to plague a forge!

Climb down into the Slag Pits, find the roost and then wipe out every bat in it -- nest and all. The bounty is 100 gold.

reminder.speaker: Dobrin
reminder.text: The Fire Bats grow strong on raw heat, which they draw from the lava vents deep under the abandoned workings.

completion.speaker: Dobrin
completion.text: No doubt the smiths will sleep better now, so take this gold with their thanks.

journal.text: Clear the Fire Bats from the Slag Pits.

variants.specifics: Vellin Cross: Gormley, keeper of the Gold Goose, wants the bats of the Gray Quarry destroyed.

offer.speaker: Gormley
offer.text:
Welcome, brave Adventurer, to Vellin Cross! At last, help has come!

Those wretched bats in the Gray Quarry are out of control! Every night now they swoop down on the inn and scare my guests off! My stableboy ran after them yesterday and still isn't back.

Head west to the Gray Quarry and wipe out the bats in their roost. Once it's done, come back to me. You'll find me pouring ale at the Gold Goose.

reminder.speaker: Gormley
reminder.text: Hurry off! The bats grow bolder.

completion.speaker: Gormley
completion.text: Take your gold, I'm awfully busy today.

journal.text: Clear the bats from the back of the Gray Quarry.

variants.specifics: Tarrow: Mott the goatherd, stuck up a haystack with a hurt leg, pays to be rid of the wolves denning in Grisk Hollow.

offer.speaker: Mott
offer.text: Kind sir! You've got to hurry and drive off these wolves! The Ogres were indeed the ones who chased this pack into our valley, and the beasts have a taste for my goats. Sadly, I hurt my leg when they ran me up this haystack and I can't fight them off by myself. The pack has made its den in Grisk Hollow west of here, spoiling any hope of grazing in peace.

completion.speaker: Mott
completion.text: Here's 80 gold for the hero of Grisk Hollow!

journal.text: Enter Grisk Hollow and slay the wolves.
